headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Resideo / Honeywell Home WiFi Water Leak & Freeze Detectors. Use the **Link your Resideo account** panel above to sign in and populate your credentials.

name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin instance name shown in the Homebridge log.

credentials.description: OAuth2 credentials and tokens. Managed by the 'Link your Resideo account' panel above; not shown in this form.

refreshRate.title: Refresh Rate (seconds)
refreshRate.description: How often to poll Resideo for device status. Allowed range 30–86400 (24h). Out-of-range values are clamped.

freezeThresholdCelsius.title: Default Freeze Threshold (°C)
freezeThresholdCelsius.description: Optional. Temperature at or below which the optional freeze sensor trips. Must be between -40 and 40 °C; values outside that range are ignored. Leave blank to use each device's own configured low-temperature limit (falling back to 4 °C if the device reports none). A per-device override takes precedence.

diagnosticsInterval.title: Diagnostics Interval (seconds)
diagnosticsInterval.description: Emit a periodic plugin health report to the log every N seconds. Default 10800 (3 hours). Set to 0 to disable. Allowed range 0–86400 (24h); values between 1 and 29 are clamped up to 30.

structuredLogs.title: Structured (JSON) Logs
structuredLogs.description: When diagnostics are enabled (diagnosticsInterval > 0), also emit each diagnostics report as a machine-readable JSON line alongside the human-readable summary. Has no effect while diagnostics are disabled.

deviceID.title: Device ID
deviceID.description: Required for the override to apply. Entries without a Device ID are ignored by the plugin.

enableFreezeSensor.title: Expose Freeze Sensor
enableFreezeSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor that trips when temperature is at or below the freeze threshold.

freezeThresholdCelsius.title: Freeze Threshold Override (°C)
freezeThresholdCelsius.description: Must be between -40 and 40 °C; values outside that range are ignored and the default applies.

layout.title: Per-Device Options
layout.description: Optional per-detector overrides. Leave this empty to apply the settings above to every detector.
